description: This PHP source file defines a Generator class within the Todaymade\Daux\Format\Confluence namespace. The class implements methods for generating and publishing content in Confluence format, including configuration checking, recursive content tree processing, and publishing. It interfaces with other components like ContentType handling, Content, Directory, and Publisher, and is integral to converting documentation trees into Confluence pages.

classes.name: Generator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating, processing, and publishing content in Confluence format from documentation trees. Implements configuration validation, recursive content tree traversal, and coordination with Publisher for content deployment.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Generator with a Daux instance and optional Api object, performing configuration checks.

methods.name: checkConfiguration
methods.description: Validates presence of mandatory Confluence configuration options and ensures that either an ancestor or root ID is set.

methods.name: getContentTypes
methods.description: Returns an array of ContentType objects representing supported content types, e.g., Markdown.

methods.name: generateAll
methods.description: Main method to generate the content tree and publish it to Confluence, coordinating with helper methods and the Publisher class.

methods.name: generateRecursive
methods.description: Recursively traverses the content directory tree to structure data for Confluence pages, assigning titles, handling nested directories, and content pages.
